'''Necropolis''' was a giant crypt located on the artificial [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Iokath]], accessed through the [[Tributary]]. It was the resting place for billions of [[Unidentified Iokath species|Iokath creators]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] that wiped itself out during the [[Iokath Civil War]]. In [[3630 BBY]], [[Vette]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] visited the Necropolis while looking for another exit from the Tributary.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Necropolis appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' "Chapter IV: Where Dreams Die" and "Chapter V: Ascension."<ref name="SWTOR" />
